أَفْطَسُ A man (S) having the bone of his nose wide and depressed; (M;) or depressed and ex-
panded: (S, K:) having his nose spreading upon his face: (K:) fem. فطْسَآءُ. (M, K.) And it is also applied as an epithet to the nose itself [as meaning Having its bone wide and expanded; &c.]. (A in art. نفس.) ―
-b2- تَمْرَةٌ فَطْسَآءُ means A date small in the drupe, having the base cleaving [to it]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
